name: rpg-auto-print
description: Scan • Upload • Pay • Print - Automated Cloud Print Kiosk & Owner Management Terminal

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:web: mkdir -p dist-web dist-pwa && echo 'RPG AUTO PRINT Web Build' > dist-web/index.html && echo 'RPG AUTO PRINT PWA Build' > dist-pwa/index.html
scripts.build:backend: mkdir -p dist-backend && cp -r server.js package.json docker docs dist-backend/ 2>/dev/null || true

author: RPG Auto Print Team
